rules.title: Machine modes
rules.description: Choose + to add a mode or an existing mode to edit. When any mode is enabled, its conditions replace single-input priority resolution. No match uses the no-active state. Offline always takes precedence.

mode.title: Configure mode
mode.description: Use any mode name: Fan, Laser emission, Bending. Category and accounting are independent. Higher priority wins overlapping matches.

conditions.title: Mode conditions
conditions.description:
Mode {mode}, group {group}. Conditions within a group use AND. Additional groups use OR. Ignore means no condition. Unknown or disabled inputs match neither ON nor OFF.
